title: origanum serpylloides
intro: Origanum serpylloides, commonly known as Creeping Thyme, is a low-growing, spreading herbaceous perennial plant in the mint family (Lamiaceae). It is a member of the Origanum genus, native to the Mediterranean region and Western Asia. The health benefits of Creeping Thyme include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce fever. The bioactive constituents of Creeping Thyme, including carvacrol and thymol, exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antiseptic, and anti-fungal properties.
